column1: # Island UI: how to get each item, the English template, copied from src/IslandUI/Data/item-guide.tsv
# by the build. Do not edit this file: the English is built into the DLL.
# To translate, copy it to plugins/IslandUI/Localization/<lang>/item-guide.tsv and
# translate the text after the tab. Keep the item id before it, and "; " between the
# ways to get it (each becomes its own line). Name items and places as the game names
# them in your language, so the player finds what the line says.
# Columns are separated by one tab. A row left out stays English.
# How to get an item: item_id<TAB>ways to get it, separated by "; ".
# Our own English, from the facts collected by the community wiki
# (madisland.wikiru.jp, "アイテム一覧"); places and items named as the game names them.
